messages.content: 在一場撲克遊戲中，確定贏家是誰，約翰手中有8♥、10♥、J♥、Q♥、K♥，邁克手中有9♠、J♠、10♠、Q♠、K♠。

function.name: card_games_poker_determine_winner
function.description: Determines the winner in a game of Poker based on the cards in each players' hands. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

hand1.description: The list of cards (as strings) in first player's hand. E.g ['10♠', 'J♠']

hand2.description: The list of cards (as strings) in second player's hand. E.g ['9♥', '10♥']

message.content:
在這兩手牌中，約翰和邁克都拿到了「順子同花」——即五張連續且同一花色的牌。  
- 約翰的牌是 **8♥‑10♥‑J♥‑Q♥‑K♥**  
- 邁克的牌是 **9♠‑10♠‑J♠‑Q♠‑K♠**

順子同花的大小比較方式是先看最高牌，若最高牌相同則再比第二高牌，以此類推。  
兩手牌的最高牌都是 K，第二高牌都是 Q，第三高牌都是 J，第四高牌都是 10，最後比較最低牌：  
- 約翰的最低牌是 8  
- 邁克的最低牌是 9  

因為 9 > 8，邁克的順子同花更高，故邁克贏得這局撲克。
message.reasoning: We need to determine winner. John has 8♥,10♥,J♥,Q♥,K♥. That's a straight flush? Actually 8-10-J-Q-K hearts: that's a straight flush (8-10-J-Q-K). Mike has 9♠,J♠,10♠,Q♠,K♠: that's also a straight flush 9-10-J-Q-K. In poker, higher straight flush wins. John's highest card is K hearts, Mike's highest is K spades. But compare the highest card of the straight flush: John's straight flush is 8-10-J-Q-K, Mike's is 9-10-J-Q-K. The higher straight flush is the one with the higher top card. Both have K as top card. But the next card: John's next highest is Q, Mike's next is Q. Next J vs J. Next 10 vs 10. Next 8 vs 9. So Mike's straight flush is higher because the 5th card (lowest) is higher? Actually ranking of straight flush: compare highest card. If tie, compare next highest? But standard rule: compare highest card; if tie, compare next highest, etc. So Mike's lowest card is 9 vs 8, so Mike wins. So answer: Mike wins.
